name: loss_mitigation_forms
title: Loss-mitigation forms — feature coding
description: PROVISIONAL / PARTLY ASSISTANT-CODED seed dataset. A morphological coding of arrangements that mitigate loss WITHOUT an entity, sorted by Harris's (2023) three-way distinction: allocation (risk assigned to a named party by contract - sea loan, bottomry, respondentia, [withheld 2026-09-28: names a form under re-coding]), spreading (transferred to third parties for a premium - marine insurance), and pooling (mutualised among stakeholders - general average, averia, ko/mujin, confraternity funds). Harris's own open question - under which conditions risk was spread as opposed to pooled or allocated - is what MC1 is for. Stored long/tidy. Carries the same WP1 component vocabulary as organizational_forms, so the packages join at component level. RULE: a characteristic lives in exactly one dataset; forms suffixed _alloc are cross-references to organizational_forms entries, coded here only on loss-allocation characteristics and never on the entity characteristics coded there. Rows with coder 'ai' are provisional.

fields.name: record_id
fields.title: Record ID
fields.description: Stable unique identifier for the coding. Never reused.

fields.name: type_id
fields.title: Pooling form (coded)
fields.description: Coded pooling arrangement. Controlled vocabulary: vocabularies/cooperative_pooling_type.csv. Not enum-constrained here because the census is still growing (CONTRIBUTING §5).

fields.name: char_id
fields.title: Characteristic (coded)
fields.description: Coded structural characteristic. Controlled vocabulary: vocabularies/cooperative_pooling_characteristic.csv, which also gives each characteristic's value type, allowed values, and WP1 component.

fields.name: value
fields.title: Coded state
fields.description: The characteristic's state for this form. Ternary characteristics: 1 present, P partial, 0 absent. Nominal characteristics: one of that characteristic's allowed categories. Absence (0) is a datum, kept distinct from .NA (inapplicable) and .NR (not yet coded).

fields.name: confidence
fields.title: Record confidence
fields.description: Confidence in the coding. Orthogonal to value.

fields.name: articulation
fields.title: Articulation
fields.description: Whether the coded function was articulated by the tradition's own advocates in their own idiom ('articulated'), or is visible only under the analyst's description ('analyst-imposed'). '.NR' where not yet assessed; propagates '.NA' with the value. 'articulated' must never rest on a placeholder citation.

fields.name: source_ref
fields.title: Source reference
fields.description: Short citation supporting the coding, or '[verify]' where the value is asserted pending a pinned reference.

fields.name: source_lang
fields.title: Source language
fields.description: Language of source_ref. ISO 639-1 where a two-letter code exists, otherwise ISO 639-3.

fields.name: coder
fields.title: Coder
fields.description: Initials of the team member who entered the record. 'ai' marks a provisional assistant-generated seed coding pending human verification. The model and effort setting of an 'ai' coding are carried in `coder_model` and `coder_effort`.

fields.name: source_read
fields.title: Source read
fields.description: Whether the coder had read source_ref when the cell was entered, or has since. 'full' = read throughout; 'partial' = read the cited passages and their context; 'none' = coded from secondary description without opening the source; 'unknown' = not recorded at coding time. '.NA' where the row has no source. PROCESS METADATA, NOT A CLAIM ABOUT THE SOURCE.

fields.name: reviewed_by
fields.title: Reviewed by
fields.description: Initials of the team member who has checked this cell, or 'none'. Distinct from 'coder'. Multiple reviewers separated by ';'.

fields.name: review_status
fields.title: Review status
fields.description: 'unreviewed' (default); 'source-checked' = a reviewer read source_ref and confirms the cell against it; 'coding-checked' = a reviewer accepts the reasoning but did not or could not verify against the source, which is the honest state where source_lang lies outside the reviewer's languages; 'disputed' = a reviewer disagrees and resolution is pending.

fields.name: notes
fields.title: Notes
fields.description: Free-text coder note: rationale, the school that dissents, caveats, cross-references.

fields.name: coder_model
fields.title: Coder model
fields.description: Identifier of the AI model that produced the value currently in this row, where `coder` is 'ai' (e.g. `claude-opus-5`); `.NA` where the coder is a person; `.NR` where not recorded. Back-filled on 2026-09-26 for every row then in the census, on the maintainer's statement that all cells to that date were coded by Claude Opus 5 at effort 'high' (logbook 1, 2026-09-26). When an adjudicated re-coding replaces a value, this field changes with it; the superseded coding survives in `recodings.csv`.

fields.name: coder_effort
fields.title: Coder effort
fields.description: Named effort (reasoning-budget) setting under which `coder_model` produced this row's value; `.NA` where the coder is a person; `.NR` where not recorded. Named levels are not comparable across models: 'high' on one model is not the same budget as 'high' on another, so compare codings by the pair (`coder_model`, `coder_effort`), never by this field alone.

fields.name: recoding_id
fields.title: Recoding ID
fields.description: Identifier of one re-coding of one cell in one pass. `LM-R` plus four digits, taken as max(existing)+1.

fields.name: record_id
fields.title: Record ID
fields.description: The `data.csv` row this re-coding tests. Several re-codings may point at one row, one per pass.

fields.name: type_id
fields.title: Pooling form (coded)
fields.description: Form code, copied from the tested row so that this file can be read on its own.

fields.name: char_id
fields.title: Characteristic (coded)
fields.description: Characteristic code, copied from the tested row so that this file can be read on its own.

fields.name: pass
fields.title: Pass
fields.description: Slug of the re-coding pass, as named in its `records/` notes and its logbook 4 entry.

fields.name: recoded_on
fields.title: Recoded on
fields.description: Date the re-coded value was fixed (ISO 8601).

fields.name: condition
fields.title: Condition
fields.description: `blind` if the re-coder did not see the existing value or the operator's expectations before fixing this one; `open` otherwise.

fields.name: coder
fields.title: Coder
fields.description: Initials of the team member who entered the record. 'ai' marks a provisional assistant-generated seed coding pending human verification. The model and effort setting of an 'ai' coding are carried in `coder_model` and `coder_effort`.

fields.name: coder_model
fields.title: Coder model
fields.description: Model that produced the re-coded value, where `coder` is 'ai'; `.NA` for a person.

fields.name: coder_effort
fields.title: Coder effort
fields.description: Named effort setting of the re-coding; not comparable across models (see `data.csv`).

fields.name: value
fields.title: Coded state
fields.description: The re-coded value.

fields.name: confidence
fields.title: Record confidence
fields.description: Confidence in the coding. Orthogonal to value.

fields.name: articulation
fields.title: Articulation
fields.description: Whether the coded function was articulated by the tradition's own advocates in their own idiom ('articulated'), or is visible only under the analyst's description ('analyst-imposed'). '.NR' where not yet assessed; propagates '.NA' with the value. 'articulated' must never rest on a placeholder citation.

fields.name: source_ref
fields.title: Source reference
fields.description: Short citation supporting the coding, or '[verify]' where the value is asserted pending a pinned reference.

fields.name: source_lang
fields.title: Source language
fields.description: Language of source_ref. ISO 639-1 where a two-letter code exists, otherwise ISO 639-3.

fields.name: source_read
fields.title: Source read
fields.description: Whether the coder had read source_ref when the cell was entered, or has since. 'full' = read throughout; 'partial' = read the cited passages and their context; 'none' = coded from secondary description without opening the source; 'unknown' = not recorded at coding time. '.NA' where the row has no source. PROCESS METADATA, NOT A CLAIM ABOUT THE SOURCE.

fields.name: value_at_recoding
fields.title: Value at recoding
fields.description: The `data.csv` value of the tested row when this re-coding was fixed. Kept because `data.csv` may later change; agreement is scored against this, not against the current value.

fields.name: agreement
fields.title: Agreement
fields.description: Whether `value` equals `value_at_recoding`.

fields.name: adjudication
fields.title: Adjudication
fields.description: `pending` until a person rules; `kept` if the existing value stands; `replaced` if this value was written into `data.csv` (and `coder_model`/`coder_effort` there changed with it); `disputed` if left open.

fields.name: adjudicated_by
fields.title: Adjudicated by
fields.description: Initials of the person who ruled, or 'none'.

fields.name: notes
fields.title: Notes
fields.description: Free-text coder note: rationale, the school that dissents, caveats, cross-references.

fields.name: source_class
fields.title: Source class
fields.description: Class of the source(s) in `source_ref`, judged by the cited passage, not by the container. `secondary`: a modern author's account of the institution, including documents they quote inside their own argument. `primary-transactional`: an edited or transcribed contract, notarial act, ledger, letter or court entry, including a transcription printed in an appendix to a secondary work. `primary-normative`: a code, statute, custom, sea law, fatwa or juristic treatise stating a rule. `primary-institutional`: a charter, minute, resolution, placard or register of an institution's own proceedings. `mixed`: `source_ref` cites passages of more than one class; `notes` should say which carries the value. `.NA` where the row has no source. Added 2026-09-27 (logbook 1).
